title: Monetization Decision Packet
acceptance: One decision packet covers measured-income Coin prices, forced save policy, milestone roster/reward mapping including SpiderWoodland/Settlement, decoration grid/fine/margin/caps, and visual approval.
Include ADR-0013 options and all seven questions: mechanism; per-item/bundles scope; Robux/regional prices; Listed; publishing/creator; dual-currency race; receipt storage and two-server safety.
All unanswered choices remain open; recommendations are labelled; no product IDs, paid calls, publishing, code or schema changes occur; check.sh passes.
